notes:
BOTH RED BEATS STAYED RED. John 14:6 is Jesus in the flesh in the upper room and
a red-letter KJV inks all of it.
  j1a  John 14:6  'I am the way, the truth, and the life:'
  j1b  John 14:6  'no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.'
The original build had already split the verse across two stills; that split is
kept exactly as it was, ids and all.

FRAMING SPLIT ADDED. John 14:6 in the KJV opens 'Jesus saith unto him, I am the
way...' - that clause is John writing, not Jesus speaking, and a red-letter Bible
leaves it black:
  sf6  John 14:6  'Jesus saith unto him,'  SCRIPTURE, blue.
sf6 sits on the SAME still as j1a (S3), so no artwork changes.

LIFTED - THOMAS. n1 read 'Thomas spoke up - Lord, we don't know where You're going,
so how can we know the way?' That is Thomas's actual question, John 14:5, delivered
as white narration. Added verbatim:
  s5  John 14:5  'Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the
      way?'  SCRIPTURE, blue - Thomas is an apostle, not Deity.
n1 keeps its id and its text and now works as the retelling right after him, on the
same still (S2). The video is a question and an answer, and the question was never
heard.

LIFTED - THE PROMISE THOMAS IS RESPONDING TO. n0 paraphrased 'Jesus told His
disciples He was going to prepare a place for them.' That is Jesus's own words,
John 14:2-3, and without them Thomas's question has nothing to be confused about.
Added verbatim, JESUS red:
  jv2  John 14:2-3  'In my Father's house are many mansions... that where I am,
       there ye may be also.'
n0b is NEW and retells it, on S7 (the room at peace).

RETELLING ORDER: jv2 -> n0b, s5 -> n1, j1a -> n2a + n2b, j1b -> n3a + n3b. The only
place two non-narrator blocks touch is sf6 -> j1a, which is the framing split
itself - one sentence of the KJV cut in two so the colour can be right, both halves
on one still.

WOMEN: John 14 records no woman speaking. Nothing added; nothing invented.

WHY-LAW: Thomas asked for directions and got a person. Milk framing - you are not
being handed a map you might read wrong. You are being handed a hand to hold.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: In the upper room, the night before the cross, Jesus told His disciples He was going to prepare a place for them.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you. And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again, and receive you unto myself; that where I am, there ye may be also.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: There's plenty of room in my Father's house, He told them. I'm going ahead to get your place ready — and I'm coming back for you, so that wherever I am, that's where you'll be too.

segments.speaker: scripture
segments.text: Lord, we know not whither thou goest; and how can we know the way?

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Thomas spoke up — Lord, we don't know where You're going, so how can we know the way?

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: I am the way, the truth, and the life:

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The way itself. The truth itself. The life itself — standing right there in the room with them.

segments.speaker: jesus
segments.text: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The door to the Father isn't a map to find.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Stop looking for the road. Walk with Him.

stills_wanted.S1: S1 now carries the opening narration AND the whole of John 14:2-3. Frame the promise, not just the room: the upper room after the meal, lamps low, Jesus leaning in toward the men around the table, speaking about somewhere else - and the disciples' faces not quite following him. Warmth and a coming absence in the same picture.
stills_wanted.S2: S2 now carries Thomas's verbatim question and its retelling. Frame the question honestly: Thomas half-risen from the table, hands open, brow furrowed - not defiant, just genuinely lost. The others quiet, because he asked what they were all thinking.
stills_wanted.S3: S3 now carries John's framing clause AND 'I am the way, the truth, and the life.' Frame the answer landing: Jesus turned fully toward Thomas, close, unhurried, one hand toward his own chest. The whole room falling still around a sentence about himself.
stills_wanted.S6: S6 now carries 'but by me' and its retelling. Frame the exclusivity as warmth, not a gate: Jesus's open hand extended toward the viewer's side of the frame, lamplight behind him, the doorway of the room beyond. An invitation standing in the only opening - nobody being kept out.
